geometry.total_thickness_mm.source: User-provided SD-rat geometry prior; not measured in the uploaded human-skull papers.

layers.outer_table.thickness_mm.source: Inferred layer partition under the 0.8 mm total-thickness constraint; theoretical prior.

layers.diploe.thickness_mm.source: Reduced diploe fraction relative to adult human parietal bone is assumed, not measured.

layers.inner_table.thickness_mm.source: Outer/inner compact-table asymmetry constrained qualitatively by human anatomy; theoretical prior.

layers.outer_table.porosity.source: Assumed compact-bone pore-volume fraction; requires rat micro-CT or histology calibration.

layers.diploe.porosity.source: Assumed cancellous-bone pore-volume fraction; requires rat micro-CT or histology calibration.

layers.inner_table.porosity.source: Assumed compact-bone pore-volume fraction; requires rat micro-CT or histology calibration.

layers.outer_table.initial_calcium_mol_p.source: Order-of-magnitude mineral-calcium prior based on bone-mineral composition, not rat measurement.

layers.diploe.initial_calcium_mol_per_m3.source: Reduced bulk calcium assigned to porous diploe; theoretical prior.

layers.inner_table.initial_calcium_mol_p.source: Order-of-magnitude mineral-calcium prior based on bone-mineral composition, not rat measurement.

transport.porosity_per_released_calcium_.source: Mineral-volume-to-porosity conversion prior; fit using post-rinse porosity or micro-CT.

transport.external_mass_transfer_m_per_s.source: Apparent bath-to-skull film coefficient; stirring and specimen holder dependent.

stages.acetic_acid.k_r_m3_per_mol_s.source: Apparent second-order leaching constant; no SD-rat value supplied by the papers or slides.

stages.edta.k_r_m3_per_mol_s.source: Apparent second-order chelation constant at approximately pH 7.4; pending in-vitro calibration.

electrical.archie_exponent.source: Empirical conductivity-porosity exponent for standardized post-rinse resistance estimates.

protocol_assumptions: Acetic acid is interpreted as 50% v/v, giving a nominal total concentration of 8.74 mol/L; apparent kinetics absorb non-ideal concentrated-solution effects.
The default sequence is 5 min acetic acid, 30 min EDTA at pH approximately 7.4, then 10 min saturated urea; durations are editable protocol priors.
Each stage is separated by rinsing: solid calcium and porosity are retained, while all free pore-liquid reagent concentrations are reset to zero.
Urea is transported but does not consume mineral calcium in the baseline model; no irreversible urea-swelling term is activated.
The inner surface has zero reagent flux because the isolated-skull modification problem does not include CSF or brain domains.
The electrical calculation is a standardized post-rinse series-resistance estimate, not a prediction of SSVEP SNR or PLV.

references.citation: Lin Jingxuan, study of cranial-wall thickness in extant humans, uploaded PDF pp. 21, 23-24.
references.use: Three-layer measurement approach and adult human parietal values only; no direct numeric transfer to SD rats.

references.citation: Liu Ao, human head modelling considering age-related cranial mechanical properties, uploaded PDF pp. 27, 29, 33.
references.use: Head-layer anatomy and site/age dependence; mechanical moduli are not used as transport parameters.

references.citation: Wu Xiaoming, frequency characteristics and anatomical relationships of human skull electrical impedance, uploaded PDF pp. 1-4.
references.use: Qualitative low-frequency resistive behavior and the influence of diploe; no SD-rat conductivity or 1-100 kHz characteristic frequency is transferred to SSVEP.

references.use: Effective diffusivity, Thiele modulus, effectiveness factor, Biot number, and internal/external diffusion coupling.
